Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: Failed to follow the Planner’s instruction to open and corroborate information using authoritative sources (e.g., Britannica, ThePeerage). Instead, it repeatedly ran the same generic DuckDuckGo search and relied on snippets/Wikipedia without extracting direct confirmations. This repetitive, non-progressive behavior risked propagating snippet errors (e.g., a panel listing Ralph de Stafford as father) and stalled proper verification.
